verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents alert rules on log patterns, counts, or attribute values, and alerts can be created from dashboard panels. AI agents can also manage alerts through Agent Skills and the MCP server. This covers rule-based triggering on telemetry events, but the evidence never says what actions alerts fire. Missing for 10: documented notification channels, webhooks or automated remediation actions, alert rules on metrics and traces, and independent or hands-on corroboration of alert behavior.
